Tests markdown output format via bytes extraction API

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:xberg/xberg.dart';
import 'package:xberg/src/xberg_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final input = await createExtractInputFromJson(json: '{"bytes":"pdf/fake_memo.pdf","config":{"output_format":"markdown"},"filename":"fake_memo.pdf","kind":"bytes","mime_type":"application/pdf"}');
    final config = await createExtractionConfigFromJson(json: '{"output_format":"markdown"}');
    final result = await XbergBridge.extract(input, config: config);
    stdout.writeln(result.results[0].mimeType);
    stdout.writeln(result.results[0].content);
    stdout.writeln(result.results[0].metadata.outputFormat);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
